HomePage.heroHeading: Give as a stream, not a one-time click.
HomePage.heroSubtext: StreamGive lets you support verified NGOs on Stellar with continuous, cancel-anytime donations — transparent, on-chain, and instant.

steps.title: Connect your wallet
steps.description: Freighter or any supported Stellar wallet — one click, no account to create.

steps.title: Start a stream
steps.description: Pick a verified NGO, set an amount and a rate. They get paid continuously, second by second — not in one lump sum.

steps.title: Stay in control
steps.description: Top up, adjust the rate, or cancel anytime. Unspent funds always come back to you, instantly.

Footer.tagline: StreamGive — open source, built on Stellar.

Apply.heading: Apply as an NGO
Apply.metadataDescription: Apply to receive recurring, streaming donations on StreamGive.
Apply.intro: Connect the wallet your organization will use to receive donations, then tell us about your NGO. Submitting registers that address in the on-chain registry, so your wallet will ask you to sign one transaction — that signature is what proves the address is yours.
Apply.submittedHelp: We'll review it and reach out at the contact email you provided.
Apply.alreadyPending: An application from this address is already pending review.

ApplicationStatus.pendingHelp: We'll reach out at the contact email you provided once it has been reviewed.
